title: 【私教案例】40岁老板三天收尾女大学生丨线上聊天案例讲解丨約會丨把妹丨情感丨戀愛丨約炮丨男性自我提升丨短期關係丨長期關係丨dating in china

coverage.dedup: reuse of formal mikey-sijiao-001; 12-character target containment 81.721%, formal containment 82.960%; zero additional weight

timeline.summary: Mikey introduces a claimed case involving a 40-year-old student and a woman said to be twenty years younger; identity, age, income and outcome are single-party material.
A first failed date is used to explain that moving close or touching after discomfort creates pressure and requires backing off and recalibration.
The title case begins; Mikey recommends reducing touch with an introverted date and deciding any escalation from现场 feedback rather than a script.
He recounts kissing and touching followed by refusal of sex and later withdrawal, and criticizes both the pace and proposed tea-room setting.

After the woman reportedly says they are unsuitable and should stop, the student sends long explanations; Mikey proposes a short meeting with an explicit promise not to keep bothering her if still unwanted.
The woman reportedly considers and accepts another meeting; Mikey rejects compensatory gifts and discusses emotional connection, sincerity and stopping persistent persuasion.
He says standards should not be performed before the other person has invested, then interprets the student's vague 'settled it' report as progress.
He recommends ordinary maintenance through daily-life sharing, walks and dates, then reports another meeting and sex from screenshots and student messages.
He claims the relationship became a stable sexual arrangement, then promotes his broader chat and relationship-maintenance coaching.

claims.statement: When a date shows discomfort with proximity or touch, he says to move back, stop escalating and reassess from later feedback.
claims.conditions: Consistent with a safety boundary, but later movement requires clear voluntary consent; mood or absence of resistance is not enough.

The title case is reconstructed from selected photos, WeChat screenshots, Mikey's commentary and student reports rather than continuous date footage.

visual_findings: All 28 sampled frames were reviewed. They show Mikey picture-in-picture beside selected photos and sequential WeChat screenshots, with visible private messages, faces, QR codes and contact handles.

The sequence visually matches the formal mikey-sijiao-001 review: early advice and reports, the woman's stated wish to stop or not meet, proposed repair, later student reports and claimed outcome. It confirms that the video displays those messages, not that they are authentic, complete or causally linked.
The sparse frames do not provide continuous date footage or the woman's independent account. Refusal, consent, sexual acts, age, income and continuing relationship remain single-party claims.
All images require redaction before any reuse because they contain faces, private chats and marketing/contact identifiers.

permissions.reuse_policy: Zero-weight reuse of formal mikey-sijiao-001; retain public URL/packaging and visual-match evidence only.
permissions.reason: The source is already formally represented and preserves unresolved consent, privacy, attribution, chronology and outcome risks.

limitations: Automatic transcript was not checked word-for-word against original audio.
Twenty-eight sparse frames do not equal continuous audio-visual verification or a complete chat-thread audit.
The public and formal transcripts use different ASR segmentation and wording, explaining why normalized text is highly overlapping but not identical.
The formal source's eight open review items remain open; this sparse public sample does not independently verify the woman's account or outcomes.
